slot.brief: Find absolute/local extrema of a cubic or rational function on an interval using first/second derivative tests; ask for max value.

stem: The absolute maximum value of $f(x)=x^3-3x^2-9x+4$ on $[-2,2]$ is

verdicts.working: f'(x)=3(x-3)(x+1), so the only critical point in [-2,2] is x=-1. Evaluating at -2, -1, and 2 gives 2, 9, and -18; the maximum is 9.
